summary.text: David Sampson is a Democratic state representative who has represented Georgia House District 153 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner, he succeeded CaMia Jackson in the seat.

paragraphs.text: His career experience includes owning S.A.M.P.S Footwear and Sampson Insurance.
Sampson defeated Al Wynn in the 2022 Democratic primary for House District 153 and Tracy Taylor in the 2022 general election.
In 2024 he defeated Joshua Anthony and Tracy Taylor in the Democratic primary and Brenda Battle in the general election.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture and Consumer Affairs, Human Relations and Aging, and Insurance committees.
